text:
This is an awesome tool for generating Glass Effects for any UI. 😍

It allows you to build stunning glassmorphism effects with plenty of customization options—it even supports liquid-glass and neumorphic styles.

Once you're finished tweaking your design, simply copy the generated code and drop it straight into your projects :)

Link 🔗: aethercss.lovable.app
first_comment_cta: Are you still using glassmorphism in your UI designs, or have you moved on to other styles? Let me know below! 👇
